pending_commit.commit_message: Refactor CTS retry logic to tradefed_test. The logic will be shared with GTS. This work did these things: 1. Moved all the common needed functions from cheets_CTS_N to tradfed_test like _clean_repository(), _consistent(), _tradefed_retry() etc Also moved shared variables like max_retry to tradfed_test. 2. Moved the retry logic (two loops) to tradefed_test function. 3. Made a single _run_tradefed() command that both CTS and GTS will implement to do their specific stuff when called during retry code. 4. Extracted code for computing test_name, test_command to its own function. 5. Extracted code for classifying results to own function. 6. os.path.join(cts, 'android-cts') was done everywhere so that is now self._repository. This means we can also use that variable so we don't have to figure out if its cts or gts everywhere. BUG=b:65862008 TEST=Regular CTS without rerun:cheets_CTS_N.7.1_r10.x86.CtsDumpsysHostTestCases TEST=Waiver:cheets_CTS_N.7.1_r10.arm.CtsAppTestCases TEST=Rerun by removing waiver:cheets_CTS_N.7.1_r10.arm.CtsAppTestCases Change-Id: I7a1686a74fe8e15ec7d5b46a4f929670428a9b77 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/752069 Commit-Ready: David Haddock <dhaddock@chromium.org> Tested-by: David Haddock <dhaddock@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ilja H. Friedel <ihf@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kazuhiro Inaba <kinaba@chromium.org>

Add retries to GTS. This CL makes GTS call into the retry logic in tradefed_test and 1. Renames functions to the same name as the CTS counterparts e.g _tradefed_run_command() 2. _run_tradefed() is now called during the tradefed_test retry code so added that function. 3. Added self._repository.
